data.summary_en: WorkRover trains long-horizon collaborative agents via recursive environment evolution: a harness-driven synthesis jointly constructs and aligns work context, executable tasks, and verifiers, while FCR and VTCA provide finer-grained environment repair and credit-assignment signals; the authors report WorkRover-35B-A3B outperforms Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 26.27 percentage points on JobBench.
